program: Fyrirtækjastyrkur Sproti (Sprout grant for companies), Tækniþróunarsjóður / Rannís
stopper_list: Autumn 2026 window closed 15 Sep 2026 15:00; next deadline per rules 15 Feb (not yet published); late applications rejected (https://island.is/styrkjatorg/styrkur/1-46; rules H26 2.7 https://assets.ctfassets.net/8k0h54kbe6bj/5ve9pGv87bP55hYSDMsxow/f5863e2c972592719afb9e2263e50f4a/TS_Reglur_SVM-H26.pdf)

TRAP: no Sproti cash before the 31 Jan 2027 runway end: stage-1 result within 3 months, only A1/A2 go on, contract meeting within 2 months of award, 40% paid at signing, only post-deadline costs; Fræ/Þróunarfræ (max 2M ISK) is the only all-year line (https://island.is/v/taeknithrounarsjodur/mat-og-uthlutun-taeknithrounarsjods; https://island.is/styrkjatorg/styrkur/1-46; rules H26 5.7, 6.4, 4.1; https://island.is/styrkjatorg/styrkur/1-42)
Two stages: only A1/A2 at stage 1 may submit the full application (https://island.is/styrkjatorg/styrkur/1-46)
Stage 1: nine questions Yes/Unclear/No, one No rejects (rules H26 Annex A)
Maturity stage 2-4 of 5 required; applicant picks and justifies a stage (rules H26 Annex A Q1)
Lead applicant company under 5 years from founding to deadline date (rules H26 2.1, 9.1)
Lead applicant must be an SME, group counted; individuals cannot lead (rules H26 2.1, 8.4)
Only one active development grant as lead applicant; no Sproti and Vöxtur together (rules H26 2, 2.1)
De minimis EUR 300,000 over two previous fiscal years plus the current one including this grant; Fræ counts (rules H26 8.1, Table 1; https://island.is/styrkjatorg/styrkur/1-42)
Caps 24M ISK over 2 years, max 12M a year; board confirms one year at a time (https://island.is/styrkjatorg/styrkur/1-46; rules H26 2.1, 7.5)
Booked cost at least equal to the grant (rules H26 2.1)
Market infrastructure max 10% of total cost or rejected without review (rules H26 2.1, 9.1)
Lead applicant at least 60% of the grant each year (rules H26 2.1, 9.1)
Only costs after the application deadline and within the contract period (rules H26 4.1)
Salaries = paid wages plus charges; no billed rates (rules H26 4.1.1)
Purchased services only from an unrelated legal entity (rules H26 4.1.3)
No equipment purchases; depreciation of specialised equipment only (rules H26 4.1.5)
Overhead max 25% of total cost minus purchased services (rules H26 4.1.6)
Application must be complete, all sections filled, or rejected (rules H26 9.1)
Fund's form unaltered, headings not removed; false or misleading information means rejection (rules H26 3.3)
Short public title and description in Icelandic and English, nothing patentable (rules H26 3.3, 5.1)
Contacting the expert panel or board means rejection (rules H26 5.3)
Generative AI in the project must be declared (rules H26 1.4)

B: University co-applicant must cover at least 20% of its own cost: that rule is in the Vöxtur section (2.2); Sproti 2.1 requires no matching contribution from applicants
